articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on SWE-Bench Full over GPT-4.5, with notably stronger performance on multi-file refactoring and architectural reasoning tasks. The model also introduces persistent project memory, allowing it to maintain context across sessions for long-running engineering workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves New SOTA on Scientific Literature Synthesis
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2 with a 2-million-token effective context window and new retrieval-augmented chain-of-thought capabilities purpose-built for scientific research. The model demonstrated the ability to synthesize findings across hundreds of papers and identify novel cross-domain research hypotheses that were subsequently validated by human reviewers. Google is integrating it directly into Google Scholar and its internal drug discovery pipelines at Isomorphic Labs.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots in Amazon and DHL warehouses under supervised autonomy, marking the first large-scale third-party commercial rollout. The robots handle bin picking, pallet stacking, and inventory scanning with a reported 97.3% task completion rate. Tesla credits its end-to-end vision-to-action transformer architecture, trained on over 18 months of teleoperation data from its own factories.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Robots Begin Autonomous Assembly Line Tasks at BMW
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at an $18 billion valuation, fueled by production deployments of its Figure 02 humanoid at BMW's Spartanburg plant. The robots now autonomously perform wiring harness installation and quality inspection steps that were previously manual-only. Figure's approach leverages large behavior models fine-tuned on task-specific demonstration data, with human-in-the-loop oversight gradually being reduced.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers for Enterprise AI Governance
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new suite of constitutional classifier tools that allow enterprises to define custom safety and compliance policies in natural language and enforce them as hard constraints on model outputs. The system uses a lightweight auxiliary model that runs in parallel with Claude during inference, enabling real-time policy adherence without significant latency overhead. Early adopters in financial services and healthcare report a 90% reduction in policy-violating outputs compared to prompt-based guardrails alone.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) transistor process node at its Kaohsiung fab, with NVIDIA and Broadcom confirmed as launch customers. The node delivers a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction over N2, which is critical for next-generation AI training chips expected to debut in early 2027. This represents a major inflection in transistor architecture as the industry fully transitions away from FinFET designs.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office has initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act's general-purpose AI model provisions, with OpenAI, Google, and Meta among the initial targets. Auditors are evaluating systemic risk assessments, compute reporting disclosures, and red-teaming documentation that foundation model providers were required to file by August 2026. The enforcement actions are being closely watched as they will set precedents for how the world's most comprehensive AI regulation is applied in practice.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2 Trillion Active Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth as a fully open-weight model featuring a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with 1.2 trillion active parameters routed from a 4.8 trillion total parameter pool. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on major reasoning and coding benchmarks while being deployable on a single 8xH200 node thanks to aggressive expert pruning and quantization techniques. The release includes a new permissive license that removes the previous 700M monthly active user restriction, accelerating enterprise adoption.
